messages.content: How would an expert use `note`? Show code.

```motoi
(define (arpeggio root notes dur vel)
  (for-each
    (lambda (n) (note n dur vel))
    notes))
(arpeggio 'C4 '(C4 E4 G4 B4) 'sixteenth 0.75)
```

Helper that iterates over a list of pitches, emitting each; teaches composition with map-like iteration over note lists.
How would an expert use `ops/eoq`? Show code.

```motoi
(define (inventory-sensitivity-analysis demand order-cost hold-cost variance-pct)
  (let* ((q-base (ops/eoq demand order-cost hold-cost))
         (q-lo (ops/eoq demand order-cost (* hold-cost (- 1 (/ variance-pct 100)))))
         (q-hi (ops/eoq demand order-cost (* hold-cost (+ 1 (/ variance-pct 100))))))
    (list 'q-nominal q-base
          'q-range (list q-lo q-hi)
          'sensitivity (/ (- q-hi q-lo) q-base))))
  (inventory-sensitivity-analysis 2000 75 3 10)
```

Analyzes how EOQ changes with ±10% variation in holding cost; useful for understanding robustness
How would an expert use `phys/quantity`? Show code.

```motoi
(define (lagrangian-state m k)
  (let ((mass-dim '((length . 0) (mass . 1) (time . 0)))
        (spring-dim '((length . 0) (mass . 0) (time . -2))))
    (list (phys/quantity m mass-dim)
          (phys/quantity k spring-dim))))
(lagrangian-state 2.0 100.0)
```

Constructs mass and spring-constant quantities for a harmonic-oscillator setup; each carries its own dimensional semantics.

How would an expert use `synth/orchestra`? Show code.

```motoi
(define (set-acoustic-mood mood)
  (cond
    ((eq? mood 'intimate) (synth/orchestra 'chamber))
    ((eq? mood 'grand) (synth/orchestra 'concert))
    ((eq? mood 'dry) (synth/orchestra 'studio))
    (else (escalate 'unknown-mood null))))
(set-acoustic-mood 'grand)
(synth/orch 'trumpet 72 0.5 0.9 'staccato)
```

Dispatch on a semantic mood tag to choose the acoustic environment; use in scene transitions or game states.

How would an expert use `entity/glide!`? Show code.

```motoi
(define (choreograph-sequence entity points ease-name)
  (define (next-waypoint pts)
    (if (null? pts)
      'sequence-done
      (let ((pt (car pts)))
        (entity/glide! entity (car pt) (cadr pt) 20 ease-name)
        pts)))
  (next-waypoint points))
(let ((dancer (world/spawn 'dancer 100 100)))
  (choreograph-sequence dancer '((150 100) (150 200) (100 200)) 'in-out))
```

Choreograph a multi-waypoint sequence with a named easing curve; the sequence is initiated but not yet driven by events.

Write an expert Motoi example that uses `matrix/=`.

```motoi
(define (test-commutativity A B)
  (if (matrix/= (matrix/* A B) (matrix/* B A))
      'commutes
      'does-not-commute))
(list (test-commutativity (matrix/identity 2) '((2 0)(0 2)))
      (test-commutativity '((1 1)(0 1)) '((1 0)(1 1))))
```

Test algebraic property. First pair (diagonal + identity) commutes; second (two shears in different directions) does not. Returns (commutes does-not-commute).
